subtitle.label: Atari Lynx II Edition - 16-Bit Grid Logic Challenge

lcd_toggle.hint: Pixel grid over the 16-Bit Retro view

init_failed.label: The game could not start. Check your connection and try again.

config_load.label: The configuration file {source} is missing or invalid.

procedural_toast.label: Endless mode, seed {seed}: starting at level {level}. New levels are built as you play, each one proven solvable!

procedural_error.label: The level generator could not build this pack. Please try again.

seed_hint.label: Empty means a random seed. The same seed gives the same levels again.

seed_invalid.label: A seed is a whole number from 0 to {max}.

start_level_hint.label: Any level from 1, there is no last level. Your last run is proposed again.

start_level_invalid.label: A level is a whole number, 1 or more.

procedural_seed_copy_failed.label: Could not copy the seed. Select it and copy it by hand.

imported_toast.label: Pack "{name}" ({count, plural, one {# level} other {# levels}}) imported successfully!

invalid_level_error.label: Import cancelled: level "{id}" has no valid player start on the grid.

delete_confirm.label: Delete pack "{name}" and all its levels? This cannot be undone.

bezel.brand: ATARI LYNX II - 16-BIT COLOR HANDHELD SYSTEM

gesture_hint.label: Swipe/Hold to move - Tap to pathfind - Pinch to zoom

press_resume.label: Press P, Space, or Resume to continue

block_hint.label: Hint: the next push is played for you. Press Help again for the following one.

quality_lowered.label: Graphics quality lowered to {quality} to keep the game smooth.

blocks_stuck.label: Dead end: these blocks can no longer cover every button. Undo (U) or restart (R).

objective_found.label: Next objective located at ({x}, {y}) - Mechanism wires visible

solution_playing.label: Playing the proven solution. Tap the board to take back control.

solution_confirm.label: Show the solution? The level restarts and plays itself to the exit.

no_solution.label: No stored solution for this level (imported packs have none).

replaying_banner.label: REPLAYING SOLUTION ({step}/{total}) - Click or press any key to take control

death_water.label: Splash! You cannot swim without Flippers!

death_fire.label: Ouch! Don't step into fire without Fire Boots!

death_bomb.label: BOOM! You stepped on a bomb!

thief_stole.label: The Thief confiscated all your boots!

socket_locked.label: Collect all chips before unlocking the socket!

all_levels_won.label: CONGRATULATIONS! You mastered every level of Epoxy!

pack_wrapped.label: End of pack reached: back to level 1.

kb_click.label: Left Click / Tap: Auto-pathfind (A*) to tile

kb_undo.label: U / Backspace / Ctrl+Z: Rewind step (even after death)

kb_objective.label: H: Locate next objective & reveal mechanism wires

kb_solution.label: O: Watch the proven solution (the level restarts)

kb_fov.label: V / Tab / Wheel: Cycle viewport zoom (9x9 to 32x32)

kb_graphics.label: G: Toggle HD Neon / 16-Bit Retro rendering

kb_theme.label: B: Cycle visual biome & music track

kb_shell.label: L: Toggle Atari Lynx II handheld shell

kb_procedural.label: N: Start an endless run of solvable levels

rule_keys.label: Keys & Doors: Red (◆), Blue (▲), Yellow (+) are single-use. Green Master Key (◯) is infinite.

rule_buttons.label: Buttons: Green (◯) toggles walls | Blue (▲) reverses Tanks | Brown (+) opens traps | Red (◆) triggers cloners.

rule_boots.label: Boots: Flippers (Water), Fire Boots (Fire), Ice Skates (Ice), Suction Boots (Force floors). Watch out for the Thief!

valid.label: Level is 100% valid and solvable ({chips}/{required} reachable chips, exit reachable)!

no_exit.label: Error: No Exit Portal (E) placed on the map.

missing_chips.label: Error: Only {placed, plural, one {# chip} other {# chips}} placed for {required} required.

no_matching_key.label: Error: {doors, plural, one {# door requires} other {# doors require}} {key} but no matching key exists.

fewer_keys_than_doors.label: Warning: {doors, plural, one {# door} other {# doors}} for only {keys, plural, one {# key} other {# keys}} ({key}).

unreachable_chips.label: Error: Only {reachable}/{required, plural, one {# chip is} other {# chips are}} reachable from start.

unreachable_exit.label: Error: The Exit Portal is blocked or unreachable.

socket_bypass.label: Error: The Exit can be reached without passing the Socket.

invalid_start.label: Error: The player start is outside the map.

generated.label: Generated difficulty {number} from seed {seed}: proven solvable in {moves} moves. Retouch it, then save or export.

failed.label: The generator could not build this level. Try another seed.

confirm_discard.label: Unsaved map changes will be lost. Continue?

confirm_reload.label: The editor has unsaved changes. Replace them with the current level?

confirm_test_invalid.label:
This level has problems: {issues}

Test it anyway?

ready.label: Left-click: paint | Right-click: erase | Alt+Click: eyedropper

saved.label: Level saved to local browser library!

invalid_level.label: Import cancelled: level "{id}" has no valid player start on the grid.

wire_select_source.label: Click the trigger button on the map...

wire_select_target.label: Now click the target mechanism to link...

level_1.title: First Locks
level_1.hint: Each colored door needs a key of its color. Find the key, then the door.

level_2.title: Moving Floors
level_2.hint: Force floors carry you along. Step on and let them take you.

level_3.title: Thin Ice
level_3.hint: On ice you slide until something stops you. Corners turn your slide.

level_4.title: Keyed Conveyors
level_4.hint: Keys and force floors together: plan where the floor drops you.

level_5.title: Into the Fire
level_5.hint: Fire burns without fire boots. Find them first.

level_6.title: Deep Water
level_6.hint: Water drowns you without flippers. Grab them before you swim.

level_7.title: Moving Hazards
level_7.hint: Monsters follow fixed paths. Watch them, then slip through the gap.

level_8.title: Elements
level_8.hint: Fire, water and ice in one run. Boots change everything.

level_9.title: Bridge Builder
level_9.hint: Push a block into water to make dirt you can walk on.

level_10.title: Demolition
level_10.hint: Bombs destroy whatever touches them. Let a block take the blast.

level_11.title: Guarded Doors
level_11.hint: Monsters patrol near the doors. Time your run to the keys.

level_12.title: Switchyard
level_12.hint: Green buttons flip every toggle wall, and doors still want their keys. Count your presses.

level_13.title: Held Open
level_13.hint: Brown buttons hold traps open: cover every button with a block. Order matters, so keep a free spot to push from. Stuck? Help plays the next push.

level_14.title: Conveyor Works
level_14.hint: Blocks ride force floors too. Push them where the floor helps.

level_15.title: Quantum Ice
level_15.hint: Teleporters send you out of the other pad, moving the same way. On ice, that matters.

level_16.title: Thieves' Den
level_16.hint: The thief takes all your boots. Use them before you meet him.

level_17.title: Slippery Patrol
level_17.hint: Monsters, ice and force floors. Read the patterns before you commit.

level_18.title: Locks and Floods
level_18.hint: Keys behind water, water behind blocks. Work backwards from the exit.

level_19.title: Controlled Chaos
level_19.hint: Monsters, bombs and toggle walls. Keep a cool head.

level_20.title: Epoxy Core
level_20.hint: Everything you learned, in one long run. Take your time.

keys_doors.title: Locksmith Run #{number}
keys_doors.hint: Each colored door eats a key of its color. Green keys open every green door.

fire.title: Ember Crossing #{number}
fire.hint: Fire burns without fire boots. Look for them before you step in.

water.title: Flooded Halls #{number}
water.hint: Water drowns you without flippers. Grab them first.

blocks_water.title: Bridge Builders #{number}
blocks_water.hint: Push a block into water to turn it into dirt you can walk on. Plan the push before you move.

ice.title: Glacier Drift #{number}
ice.hint: Ice keeps you sliding until something stops you. Corners turn your slide.

force.title: Conveyor Works #{number}
force.hint: Force floors carry you along. Force boots let you walk against them.

thief.title: Thieves' Den #{number}
thief.hint: The thief takes all your boots. Use them before you meet him.

toggle_walls.title: Switchyard #{number}
toggle_walls.hint: Every green button flips every toggle wall. Count your presses.

trap.title: Bear Trap Alley #{number}
trap.hint: A bear trap holds you until its brown button is pressed. A block can keep the button down.

teleport.title: Quantum Hop #{number}
teleport.hint: Step on a teleporter to come out of another one, moving the same way. With several pads, the order you use them matters.

sokoban.title: Warehouse #{number}
sokoban.hint: Every brown button holds a trap open. Push a block onto each button, and never into a corner.

monsters.title: Creature Feature #{number}
monsters.hint: Monsters follow fixed patterns. Watch them, wait for the gap, then move.

bomb.title: Demolition Run #{number}
bomb.hint: Bombs blow up anything that touches them. Push a block into one to clear the way.

cloner.title: Clone Works #{number}
cloner.hint: A red button makes the clone machine drop a copy of its block. Clone as many blocks as the job needs.

default.hint: Use the Objective button (or H) to locate the next mechanism and inspect trap, cloner, and toggle wires.
